config.advertiser_summary: An eco-friendly brand offering refillable, concentrated cleaning products designed to replace single-use plastic bottles with performance comparable to big brands.

assumptions: Price not given; assumed $60 for a 'unknown' product.
Gross margin not given; assumed 55% (typical for home).
repeat_consumable: assumed 2.5 orders per customer over ~6 months.
Target CPA = 70% of max affordable CAC ($60 x 55% margin x 2.5 orders = $82.50).

pricing.rationale: Acquisition goal with no conversion history: pay per click. Max CPC = target CPA $57.75 x click-to-purchase rate (1.5%-5.0%). Clicks are observable without trusting a pixel, so both sides can verify billing.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded; until then Disco can't predict conversion rate for this brand.

budget.pacing: even daily pacing; pause a host if CPA > 2.0x target after 150 clicks

allocations.rationale: score 0.37 -> fit x1.40 on CTR/CVR; max bid $2.43 (break-even at target CPA), start at 70% and raise only if under-delivering; host sells a competing product, so it may decline (capacity discounted)
